entities.name: Exploit Public-facing Application
entities.evidence: Actor used public-facing applications to gain initial access to systems; in this case, Earthworm and PortProxy.

entities.name: Windows Management Instrumentation
entities.evidence: The actor executed WMIC commands to create a copy of the SYSTEM registry.

entities.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell
entities.evidence: The actor used a PowerShell command to identify successful logons to the host.

entities.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Windows Command Shell
entities.evidence: The actor used this primary command prompt to execute a query that collected information about the storage devices on the local host.

entities.name: Server Software Component: Web Shell
entities.evidence: The actor used backdoor web servers with web shells to establish persistence to systems, including some of the webshells being derived from Awen webshell.

entities.name: Indicator Removal
entities.evidence: The actor selectively cleared Windows Event Logs, system logs, and other technical artifacts to remove evidence of their intrusion activity.

entities.name: Indicator Removal: Clear Windows Event Logs
entities.evidence: The actor cleared system event logs to hide activity of an intrusion.

entities.name: OS Credential Dumping: NTDS
entities.evidence: The actor may try to exfiltrate the ntds.dit file and the SYSTEM registry hive out of the network to perform password cracking.

entities.name: Brute Force
entities.evidence: The actor attempted to gain access to accounts with multiple password attempts.

entities.name: Brute Force: Password Spraying
entities.evidence: The actor used commonly used passwords against accounts to attempt to acquire valid credentials.

entities.name: OS Credential Dumping
entities.evidence: The actor used additional commands to obtain credentials in the environment.

entities.name: Credentials from Password Stores
entities.evidence: The actors searched for common password storage locations.

entities.name: System Information Discovery
entities.evidence: The actors executed commands to gather information about local drives.

entities.name: System Owner/User Discovery
entities.evidence: The actors gathered information about successful logons to the host using a PowerShell command.

entities.name: Permission Groups Discovery: Local Groups
entities.evidence: The actors attempt to find local system groups and permission settings.

entities.name: Permission Groups Discovery: Doman Groups
entities.evidence: The actors used commands to enumerate the active directory structure.

entities.name: System Network Configuration Discovery
entities.evidence: The actors used commands to enumerate the network topology.

entities.name: Proxy
entities.evidence: The actors used commands to enable port forwarding on the host.

entities.name: Proxy: External Proxy
entities.evidence: The actors used compromised SOHO devices (e.g. routers) to obfuscate the source of their activity.

entities.name: China
entities.evidence: Nation-State Actor : China
